newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN MINERALS DEPARTMENT CHANGES NAME.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN MINERALS DEPARTMENT CHANGES NAME.

text.p: As part of its restructuring under a new minister, the Department of Minerals and Energy Affairs has changed its name to the Department of Minerals and Energy.

Since the African National Congress' Penuell Maduna took over the ministry from the National Party's Pik Botha last year, the department has undergone extensive restructuring and has now decided to streamline its name as well, acting director general Dick Bakker told parliament on Wednesday.
